report:
Reviewed the complete lookup.completeness claim and all four implementation entries and two test entries. The claim requires represented alternatives to remain separate from exhaustiveness, forbids treating empty incomplete lookup as absence, and applies the architectural terminal-incompleteness rule. This is partial implementation with explicit outstanding work, not full lookup conformance.

The ordinary Resolver::traits_in_method_scope implementation returns trait identities plus an independent completeness boolean. It deduplicates identical trait definitions without conflating distinct providers, tracks definite scope separately, marks unresolved imports, local glob export discovery, unavailable prelude and incomplete expansion conservatively incomplete, and keeps represented candidates when completeness is false. The associated method.rs consumer combines scope completeness with bound/inherent-provider uncertainty and missing/ineligible metadata. A unique definite method is selected only without uncertainty; multiple definite methods are ambiguous; an unknown remainder produces the unsupported-or-incomplete diagnostic, and only a complete empty applicable set yields no applicable method. The associated mods.rs method-provider expansion policy rejects unresolved/failed/depth-limited macros, active attributes, errors, and unsupported derives that can hide providers. Its recursive checks and the distinction between builtin method-provider completeness and full symbol-listing completeness were inspected. Captured external trait_children only enumerates represented trait identities; it does not itself furnish a general explicit completeness product.

The fourth implementation entry in semantic_spec.rs explicitly defers a uniform completeness result across all lookup forms. That deferral is material: ordinary path/import lookup interfaces still return candidate vectors, and this review does not upgrade them to an exhaustive negative-reasoning interface. The prerequisite is propagating an explicit completeness contract through those lookup forms and their consumers while preserving alternatives.

Read both complete annotated tests. unresolved_item_macro_keeps_method_scope_incomplete parses a source fixture with unknown_items! and a derived Clone method call, locates DbDropGuard::db, checks its body, and explicitly asserts the incomplete candidate information diagnostic. Fixture setup and BuiltinDeriveTcx metadata were captured and inspected: this is a focused source-driven test with scripted external facts, not an independent rustc oracle or exhaustive external-provider validation. Its assertion establishes the conservative diagnostic for this case; it does not independently assert every retained alternative, prove absence of all other diagnostics, or cover complete-empty and ambiguity cases. The semantic_spec TODO test explicitly retains the absent/unique/ambiguous/incomplete matrix, including incomplete empty providers and definitive negative conclusions only for exhaustive emptiness. This remains justified pending the uniform interface above and focused observable fixtures; it is not executable coverage.

Captured the architectural-foundations rationale and supporting symbol/fixture dependencies. No source changes or test executions were made for this review. Commands executed were review start/read and source inspection, followed by record; centrally reported suite passes are not substituted for the deferred assertions. No additional edits requested; the broad implementation and test limitations remain visibly TODO.
